html:
Build scope

What Restaurant Fit-Out includes

F&B spaces work under heat, steam, grease and heavy traffic. The layout, materials and services have to perform through every service.

01Kitchen workflowPrep, cook, plate and service zones coordinated with your chef.
02Dining layoutSeating, bar, lounge and guest circulation.
03LightingAmbient, task and decorative layers.
04Durable surfacesAnti-slip floors and easy-clean, food-grade finishes.
05Ceilings and acousticsFire-rated and acoustic systems for busy dining rooms.
06Custom joineryBars, host stands, display and service stations.
07VentilationHoods, ducting, extract and fresh-air intake.
08Wet areasPlumbing, drainage, sinks and wash stations.

A controlled programme

6 steps from brief to handover

Decisions are approved in sequence so the site team can build with fewer changes and clearer accountability.

01

Survey and chef brief

Review the site, menu, equipment and kitchen workflow.

02

Kitchen and dining design

Approve layouts and 3D views for front and back of house.

03

Compliance review

Check ventilation, drainage, finishes and wash areas against PFA needs.

04

Construction and MEP

Coordinate build, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, ducting and hoods.

05

Equipment and finishing

Install counters, lighting, finishes and coordinate equipment.

06

Handover support

Snag, clean and prepare the venue for inspection and opening.

Indicative PKR pricing

A practical range before the survey

These planning figures come from the service scope. The proposal is fixed only after site review and specification approval.

Basic CaféPKR 7,000–9,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 14M–18M
Mid-Spec RestaurantPKR 9,000–12,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 18M–24M
Premium RestaurantPKR 12,000–16,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 24M–32M

Examples use a 2,000 sq. ft. unit. Kitchen equipment is separate unless included in the coordinated quotation.
